About Finpecia Tablet

Finpecia Tablet is used to treat symptoms of benign prostatic hypertrophy (BPH), such as frequent and difficult urination. Benign prostatic hyperplasia is a common condition that occurs when the cells of the prostate gland begin to multiply.

Finpecia Tablet contains Finasteride, which works by blocking the action of male hormones that cause prostate enlargement and hair loss. Thereby, it helps treat BPH and male pattern hair loss.

Not everyone who is taking Finpecia Tablet will get these side effects. In some cases, Finpecia Tablet may cause low sexual desire, impotence (erectile dysfunction), abnormal ejaculation, or trouble having an orgasm. Most of these side effects of Finpecia Tablet may not require medical attention and gradually resolve over time. However, if the side effects persist or worsen, please consult your doctor.

Finpecia Tablet can be taken with or without food. Swallow the medicine as a whole with a glass of water. It is advised not to take more than the recommended dose of medicine. Do not chew, bite, break, or crush the medicine.

Do not take Finpecia Tablet if you are allergic to any of its components. Finpecia Tablet is not intended for use in women and children. Keep the doctor informed about your health condition and medications to rule out any side effects/interactions. Inform your doctor if you have any history of livre, kidney, or heart problems before taking Finpecia Tablet .

Uses of Finpecia Tablet

Finpecia Tablet is used in the treatment of benign prostatic hypertrophy (BPH) and male pattern hair loss. The detailed uses of Finpecia Tablet are as follows:

  • Male Pattern Baldness (Androgenetic Alopecia): Finpecia Tablet slows hair loss and promotes regrowth in men.
  • Benign Prostatic Hyperplasia (BPH): Finpecia Tablet reduces prostate size and improves urinary symptoms.
  • Hormonal Therapy: Finpecia Tablet is used off-label for conditions related to excess DHT.

Health Queries

I am facing hair loss, and it has been worrying me lately. What can help reduce hair fall and improve hair growth naturally or with treatment?

Vikas Singh

M Pharmacy

Hair loss can happen due to stress, poor sleep, nutritional deficiency, dandruff, hormonal imbalance, illness, weight changes, thyroid problems, or family history. In many people, hair fall improves gradually after the underlying cause is corrected, but continuous shedding for a long time should not be ignored. Hair growth treatment depends on the exact reason behind the problem. Eating a balanced diet with enough protein, iron, fruits, vegetables, nuts, and water may support healthier hair growth. Avoid excessive heat styling, harsh chemical treatments, and very tight hairstyles because they can weaken hair roots further. Managing stress, sleeping properly, and maintaining regular exercise may also help overall hair health. Hair oils and shampoos may improve scalp care, but they usually do not stop severe hair loss alone. Any medicine, supplement, or hair treatment should only be started after proper medical advice. Please consult a doctor if you notice sudden severe hair fall, bald patches, scalp itching, dandruff with redness, or thinning that continues for several months.

Can 18 year old men can take it?

Bayyarapu Mahesh Kumar

M Pharmacy

It is used for different medical reasons. Because every person is different, it is not possible to say if it is safe without knowing your health condition and the medicines you are taking. Always consult a doctor so they can choose the safest and most suitable treatment for you.

After 1 year of hair fall, I tried Ayurvedic medicines, but stopped taking them, and the hair fall started again. Can I take Finpecia Tablet for hair fall now?

Dr. S Aneela

M. Pharm (Pharmacology)., PhD

Yes, you can start Finpecia Tablet (Finasteride) for hair loss even after stopping Ayurvedic medicines, as it works differently. It is most effective when used under a doctor's guidance, and it may take a few months before you notice any improvement.

I have been taking Finpecia Tablet for pattern baldness. Can I also use a topical solution to stimulate hair growth?

Dr. S Aneela

M. Pharm (Pharmacology)., PhD

Yes, you may use a topical solution like Minoxidil along with Finpecia Tablet (Finasteride), as they work in different ways to reduce hair loss and promote hair growth. Apply the solution as directed, continue taking Finpecia Tablet for the best results, and consult your doctor if you have any concerns.

Do I need to take Finpecia Tablet for life, or can I stop using it at some point?

Dr. S Aneela

M. Pharm (Pharmacology)., PhD

Finpecia Tablet (Finasteride) works only while you take it, so stopping the tablet may cause hair loss to resume. Most patients continue taking it long term to maintain results, but your doctor can advise based on your situation.

Quick Overview

Understanding Finpecia Tablet 15's

Usage & Safety

Directions for Use

  • Finpecia Tablet can be taken with or without food.
  • It is usually taken once daily at the same time each day or as prescribed by your doctor.
  • Swallow Finpecia Tablet as a whole with a glass of water.
  • Do not crush, chew, or break it.

Key Benefits

  • Finpecia Tablet belongs to a class of medicines called 5-alpha-reductase inhibitors used to treat symptoms of benign prostatic hypertrophy (BPH) in men with enlarged prostate.
  • Finpecia Tablet also may decrease the need for prostate surgery.
  • Additionally, it is also used to treat male pattern hair loss.
  • Finpecia Tablet works by blocking the action of male hormones that cause the prostate to enlarge and hair loss.

How Finpecia Tablet Works

Finpecia Tablet contains Finasteride, which works by blocking the action of male hormones that cause prostate enlargement and hair loss. Thereby, it helps treat BPH and male pattern hair loss.

What if I have taken an overdose of Finpecia Tablet

Do not take more than the prescribed dose. If you take more than the prescribed dose, please go to the emergency department of the closest hospital immediately. No specific side effects have been reported under these circumstances.

Drug Warnings

  • Do not take Finpecia Tablet if you are allergic to any of its components.
  • Inform the doctor if you have a lot of difficulty passing urine, liver or kidney problems, prostate problems, prostate cancer or depression.
  • Finpecia Tablet is intended for use in men only; it is not recommended for women and children.
  • Avoid contact with Finpecia Tablet if you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant, especially if the medicine is crushed or broken; if contact occurs, wash the area with soap and water and consult the doctor immediately.
  • Let the doctor know if you are taking any other medicines, including supplements or herbal products.
  • To treat your condition effectively, continue taking Finpecia Tablet for as long as your doctor has prescribed it. Try not to stop taking it on your own.
  • Avoid consuming alcohol along with Finpecia Tablet as it could lead to increased dizziness and drowsiness.

FinasterideSaquinavir
Severe
How does the drug interact with Finpecia Tablet:
Co-administration of Saquinavir may increase the blood levels and effects of Finpecia Tablet.

How to manage the interaction:
If you have to use Finpecia Tablet and Saquinavir together, a doctor may adjust the dose or monitor you more frequently to safely use both medications. However, if you experience increased side effects or changes in your condition, please contact a doctor. Do not discontinue the medication without consulting a doctor.
FinasterideFluvoxamine
Severe
How does the drug interact with Finpecia Tablet:
Co-administration of Finpecia Tablet and Fluvoxamine may increase the blood levels and effects of Finpecia Tablet.

How to manage the interaction:
There may be a possibility of interaction between Fluvoxamine and Finpecia Tablet, but it can be taken if prescribed by a doctor. It's important to keep an eye on blood pressure and overall health. If you notice any abnormal symptoms it's best to contact a doctor right away. Do not stop using any medications without talking to a doctor.

Diet & Lifestyle Advise

Benign prostatic hyperplasia (BPH): 

  • Avoid foods like sugars, carbonated beverages, tea, citrus fruits, tomatoes, spicy foods, chocolate and tea. 
  • Limit fluid intake, as excess fluid intake could cause an urge to urinate frequently.
  • Avoid drinking excess alcohol or caffeinated drinks, as they can worsen the symptoms.
  • Maintain a healthy weight and exercise regularly.
  • Quit smoking.
  • Avoid processed foods. Instead, choose whole, unprocessed foods.
  • Include fruits, vegetables, and fibre-rich food in your diet.

Hair loss:

  • Get your regular medical examinations done to keep a check on your hormonal profile (androgen) and nutritional deficiencies that cause hair fall.
  • It is advised to timely monitor your hormonal and vitamin D profiles, which can affect your hair loss.
  • Avoid overusing styling tools like blow dryers, curling rods, and chemical dyes. These can cause loss of natural hair oils, leading to hair fall.
  • Regular oiling helps in the blood circulation of the scalp and nourishes the roots.
  • Wash your hair twice a week with a good shampoo and conditioner to reduce hair fall.
  • Practice yoga and meditation to manage stress.

Safety Advice

Alcohol

Consult your doctor

It is not known if alcohol affects Finpecia Tablet . Please consult the doctor.

Pregnancy

Not applicable

Finpecia Tablet is not intended for use in women. Pregnant women should avoid contact with Finpecia Tablet as it may affect the normal development of the male baby’s sex organs.

Breast Feeding

Not applicable

Finpecia Tablet is not intended for use in women.

Driving

Safe if prescribed

Finpecia Tablet usually does not affect your ability to drive or operate machinery.

Liver

Caution

Caution should be exercised while using Finpecia Tablet in patients with liver impairment. Please consult the doctor if you have any concers.

Kidney

Consult your doctor

If you have any concerns regarding the use of Finpecia Tablet in patients with kidney problems, please consult the doctor.

Children

Unsafe

Finpecia Tablet is not recommended for children below 18 years as the safety and effectiveness were not established.

Heart

Safe

Finpecia Tablet is generally safe for people with heart conditions and may even offer cardiovascular benefits. Still, it's essential to consult your doctor, especially if you're on other medications or have complex heart issues.

Geriatrics

Caution

Finpecia Tablet is generally considered safe for geriatric patients. Studies have not shown age-related problems that would limit its use in older adults. However, it's still wise to consult your doctor to ensure it's appropriate for your specific health profile.
